promises.quote: Action is required to ensure that all force control operators and those likely to deal with a police pursuit are sufficiently trained and/or re-trained so that they understand their responsibilities, powers and obligations under force policy when dealing with a pursuit.

promises.summary: Ensure two staff monitor the Force Desk at all times.
